Respiratory Quotient
When oxygen consumption and carbon dioxide production 
are measured, the respiratory quotient (RQ) may be calculated 
as noted in the following equation. The RQ indicates the fuel 
mixture being metabolized. The RQ for carbohydrate is 1 be-
cause the number of carbon dioxide molecules produced is 
equal to the number of oxygen molecules consumed.
